title: Disable Xbox Services
name: disable-xbox-services
warning: Use if you only play on Steam/Riot/Epic. Do NOT use if you use PC Game Pass, Xbox App, or official Xbox wireless adapters.
modal:
**When to use:** Recommended if you only play games via Steam, Epic, or Riot and want to disable background Xbox services without uninstalling Xbox apps.

**When NOT to use:** Do NOT apply if you use **PC Game Pass**, the **Xbox App**, or Microsoft Store multiplayer games (such as *Forza Horizon* / *Sea of Thieves*).
description: Disables Xbox background services (XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxGipSvc, XboxNetApiSvc) to save RAM without uninstalling apps.
